test.what: Full check: go vet plus all tests, native build with GUI tags.

test-nogui.what: All tests without the GUI (no cgo, runs on any platform); the queqiao README's test command.

build-cli.what: Build the terminal-only binary ./magpie (CGO_ENABLED=0, cross-compiles anywhere).

build-gui.what: Build the native GUI binary (cgo webview; macOS 12+ min, GTK3 tags on Linux).

dev.what: Dev loop on ports 3426-3429: windows stay up, backend rebuilds on Go change (fswatch); falls back to dev-once.

icons.how: make icons (destructive: overwrites build/darwin icon assets; macOS tools required)

ui-preview.what: Record a local UI preview of a PR diff (DeepSeek drives the browser; never leak the key).
ui-preview.how: cd .github/ui-preview && npm install && npx playwright install chromium && DEEPSEEK_API_KEY=… DIFF_FILE=pr.diff PR_TITLE=… ./run.sh ../.. /tmp/out

site-deploy.what: Deploy the usemagpie.ai site and worker from site/.
site-deploy.how: cd site && npx wrangler deploy (destructive: publishes production usemagpie.ai)

clean.what: Remove build outputs: magpie, magpie.app, dist/, windows syso files.

release.what: Cross-build all dist/ artifacts for the current OS plus the CLI targets.
release.how: make release (destructive: runs make clean first)

none.what: None of the project tools is relevant to this request.
